notes: Dependabot ignores `onnxruntime-web`, pinned to the release known to work with `@imgly/background-removal`.
Reads the project token from `VITE_POSTHOG_KEY`, the Workers Builds variable the application already used, and fixes the host to EU Cloud whenever the token is set, so `VITE_POSTHOG_HOST` is unused.
`src/contracts/bundledPostHog.test.ts` checks that the bundled project reports to EU Cloud and stays off without a token.
Keeps the stylesheet at `src/styles/app.css`, so Tailwind's `source('../')` points at `src/`, and it also imports the Geist fonts and `@ras-sh/ui`'s styles and scans that package for classes.
The root route keeps its `shellComponent`, SEO and icon head tags, and its own error and not-found components, so the root route's error and not-found pages render inside the document.
The router keeps the application's `DefaultCatchBoundary` and `NotFound` as its default error and not-found components.

The Content Security Policy also allows `staticimgly.com`, blob module scripts, workers, and `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` for the background removal model and ONNX Runtime, and GitHub images for the footer avatar.
Keeps the `fix` script and the lefthook pre-commit hook that runs it, which the application had before adopting recipes.
Keeps the `~/*` path alias in `tsconfig.json`, which every application module imports through.
`allowBuilds` also lists `lefthook: true` for its git hook install and `protobufjs: false`, which `onnxruntime-web` pulls in.
`minimumReleaseAgeExclude` lists `ras-stack@6.0.0`, which was published inside the seven-day window when the application adopted recipes.
